name: Koi to Mahou to Kanrinin
source:
This is the first title by Prometheus. The game is divided into two parts, with each focusing on two separate heroines. 

Magic is seen only in fairy tales, movies, manga and other fiction. However, even though people cannot see it with their own eyes, it actually exists in this world. Originally it’s only used by women, but for some reason, Takeru was born with this ability. He was uncomfortable with his special ability and soon kept his distance from others.

One spring day, his grandfather, who had raised him up, passed away. It was written in his will that Takeru was to take over the management of the dormitory at the school which his grandfather had founded and was the chairman of. He thought that it would just be a simple business matter, but he never thought at that time that he would fall in love with a girl who lived there. Also, he did not notice that there was a giant organization targeting him for his ability…

[Edited from [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/08/01/august-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]

The second game focusing on Kasumi and Hisano. Takeru has been the dorm manager at Hazuki Gakuen since the beginning of the school term. When his osananajimi Kasumi and transfer student Hisano found out about this, they also moved in to the dorm and it became very rowdy every day. He had remained distant to others due to his self-hatred of his innate ability, but he gradually started to treat the girls living in the dorm like family. However, they had feelings for him and became anxious after realizing that he didn’t see them as anything more than family. At that time, a cute girl appeared from a book inside a small shrine in the backyard…

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/06/19/june-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是普罗米修斯的第一个作品。游戏分为两个部分，每个部分都聚焦于两个不同的女主角。

魔法只出现在童话、电影、漫画和其他小说中。然而，虽然人们无法亲眼看到，但它却真实存在于这个世界上。原本只有女性才能使用，但不知为何，Takeru天生就拥有这种能力。他对自己的特殊能力感到不舒服，很快就与其他人保持了距离。

一个春日，抚养他长大的祖父去世了。在他的遗嘱中写着，武将接管祖父创办并担任董事长的学校的宿舍管理工作。他以为这只是一件简单的生意事，但当时他万万没有想到，他会爱上一个住在那里的女孩。而且，他并没有注意到，有一个庞大的组织正在针对他的能力……

[编辑自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/08/01/august-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]

第二场比赛以霞和久野为中心。Takeru从学期开始就担任叶月学园的宿舍管理员。当他的小七美霞和转校生久野知道这件事后，他们也搬进了宿舍，每天都变得很吵闹。由于对自己天赋的自我厌恶，他一直对别人保持着距离，但他逐渐开始像对待家人一样对待宿舍里的女孩们。然而，他们对他有感情，并在意识到他只把他们视为家人后变得焦虑。就在这时，后院小神殿内的一本书中出现了一位可爱的女孩……

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/06/19/june-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
